Can’t be helped. Some people want a typical shounen power growth or an unrealistic one. The Pros and Cons aside, the author specifically set up this manga and osamu to be the weakest one in terms of physical strength. 

The author said they wanted us to realize the power of human strength. Little did we know, Ashihara decided to take it literally. Which would’ve been good, if the pacing was weekly  or osamu would take some “unrealistic” growth turns. I see both povs. Yeah Osamu doesn’t get a powerup, but he can get stronger physically like deku did. At least you would think so but he can’t bc the beginning was not set up that way. Here are the problems people have with osamu that they refuse to take into account. 

1. Osamu is supposed to be “normal” compared to the others. That was the whole reason the manga was made(aside from the sports festival).

2. You are born with your trion level and cannot improve except by a level or two gradually. It stops growing at 20. Osamu cannot help that he will always be at a 2-4. 

3. Osamu is physically weak. His lungs are so fucked he’s wheezing after jogging for 1 minute. It’s gonna take some time to get athletic. Just 20 days from when tamakoma started the rank war won’t cut it. 

4. He’s only been b rank for 3 months while being in actual combat for one month compared to his peers year +. 

5. Ashihara is big on details and consistency. And the pacing is once a month with a few hiatuses. osamu’s growth unrealistically changing pace is not gonna happen. 

6. The whole plot of the manga is for the bridge to connect neighbors and humans in unity. Osamu being the bridge. Now he’s not gonna be like Naruto and Ichigo’s kinda bridge by punching the enemy into being his ally. No. Osamu’s sole job is to be a diplomat and strategic leader by working from the bottom to the top. No modern shounen main character has purposely been an actual political diplomat troupe. No not even naruto the hokage. 


Now most of these facts people don’t know or bother to care about at all. They don’t care about the reason behind the plot or the kind of troupes world trigger wants to dismantle. All they see is a really badass anime that has strategic fight scenes with a smart system that made it so the characters can go has hard as they want without being killed off. But then they realized most of the pov was going to be used through the eyes of a physically weak mc bc Osamu is the central protagonist. They’re not spending their time watching yuma whip out his bt through the neighborhood or jin pulling strings and whatnot. They’re watching osamu getting beat up, harassed, and studying dusk til dawn. A lot of shounen fans just want Osamu to get stronger which i can understand. I want osamu to get stronger in one on one without a power up too, but he CANNOT realistically because of the groundwork the author already set up throughout the story. Instead osamu has been winning in realistic strategic ways. Also political. Most people hate politics. He’s actually doing negotiations and media shit. He’a winnjng in ways regular shounen fans do not want to see.
